body: CONFIRM — the final synthesis preserves the four accepted repairs exactly and introduces no contradiction. C1-A exposes only SourceManifest[UnresolvedMappings] and cannot mint checked SourceBundle, final BundleId, final EditionId, or resolved source evidence; C1-D validates every referenced canonical relation before final bundle and edition identity. C1-C owns NoCorrespondence plus shared directed-family, relation-versus-receipt, occurrence, epoch/seam, endpoint, coalescing, projection and ClockRepair laws; C1-D owns TrackComposition-specific repeat/reorder/hold/gap/set-valued-reverse laws and evidential EditionCorrespondence without a cast. C1-E separately represents stream capability, reader coverage, and boundary-provider coverage with the required non-conversion mutations. Timestamp refusals remain in B and boundary payload laws remain in E. The gate and exclusions confer no source, rights, runtime, provider, dependency, codec, compiler, or implementation authority.
